subject: Webhook retries after a timeout
preview: Could you send us the request ID from one of the failed deliveries?

messages.author: me
messages.body: Our endpoint timed out for a few minutes this morning. Will the webhooks we missed be retried?

messages.author: jonas
messages.body: Yes, every delivery is retried for up to 24 hours with backoff. Could you send us the request ID from one of the failed deliveries? I'll check they're queued.
